description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeSkill entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the database table 'hs_hr_emp_skill'. It includes properties for employee, skill, years of experience, and comments, along with getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and a decorator trait.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's skill, including references to Employee and Skill entities, along with experience years and comments.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this skill record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this skill record.

methods.name: getSkill
methods.description: Returns the Skill associated with this employee skill record.

methods.name: setSkill
methods.description: Associates a Skill with this employee skill record.

methods.name: getYearsOfExp
methods.description: Returns the number of years of experience for the skill.

methods.name: setYearsOfExp
methods.description: Sets the years of experience for the skill.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to the skill.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to the skill.
